title: Daytona API key (dtn_): benign reference controls
summary: 2 inputs holding references (variables, template expressions, secret-manager pointers) that name the credential without containing it.
rationale: A reference is the safe way to use a secret. Reporting it punishes the practice the scanner exists to encourage.

expectation.rationale: Placeholder, reference, template, mask, documentation or ordinary text. Expected silence is project policy.
